visualCharacteristics.structure: circular photo + name + role + social links

contentPattern: One row per person. Each card has an image cell (rendered as a circular avatar) followed by a body cell containing the name, a role/subtitle, and a row of social links. Rendered as a centered responsive grid.
usage: Grid of team/contributor profile cards (circular photo, name, role, social links). Used on the About Us page for Contributors and WKND Guides.
